# Geshan's Blog

> Technical blog by Geshan Manandhar — Technical Team Lead at ELMO Software in Sydney, Australia, Google Developer Expert (GDE), and conference speaker blogging since 2007. Covers software engineering, AI / Gen AI / LLMs, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Run, DevOps, software architecture, databases, and PHP.

This site provides full-content feeds and structured indexes for LLMs and AI search engines:
- [Full Post Index (llms-full.txt)](https://geshan.com.np/llms-full.txt): Complete index of all 283 blog posts with dates and descriptions.
- [Atom Feed](https://geshan.com.np/atom.xml): Full-content Atom feed of the 30 most recent posts.
- [XML Sitemap](https://geshan.com.np/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of blog posts.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://geshan.com.np/): Latest posts, popular picks, side projects, and author overview.
- [About Me](https://geshan.com.np/about/): Author biography, 17+ years of software engineering experience, public speaking, Gen AI workshops, and side projects.
- [Blog Archives](https://geshan.com.np/blog/archives/): Chronological archive of all blog posts since 2007.
- [Newsletter](https://newsletter.geshan.com.np/): Subscribe to new software engineering and AI posts.
